name: Rebuild site, buildings and storeys from CWA Level
description: One IfcSite (Project Site), an IfcBuilding per Unit + Building code, an IfcBuildingStorey per CWA Level at level number × 3 m (in the file's units), and every pour element contained in its storey. Elements without a level go in the site. Ported from ifc_spatial_structure.py.
